question: Test the reproducibility of transcription-factor RNA abundance across HPA and GTEx in colon, ovary and testis, using their separate tissue nTPM files, not the consensus file as a substitute for either source. For each tissue use transcription-factor Ensembl genes with finite nonnegative values in both sources. Report the count, Spearman correlation and median absolute log2((HPA nTPM+1)/(GTEx nTPM+1)). Compare the top twenty transcription factors from each source, giving overlap, Jaccard and the two ranked lists. Select the ten largest absolute log2 differences per tissue, ties by Ensembl ID, and add the corresponding consensus nTPM and RNA tissue specificity category. Draw per-tissue source-agreement scatters restricted to the union of the two top-twenty lists, overlap bars and a discrepancy heatmap. Supply the top-list union measurements and aggregate/discrepancy tables. Explain why consensus is not an independent third replication cohort. If a requested ranked list has fewer eligible members, return every eligible member and state the count. Use Ensembl genes present in the HPA master table as the gene universe and break all gene-ranking ties by Ensembl ID.

tool_uses.input:
{"query":"WITH base AS (
 SELECT lower(h.Tissue) tissue,h.Gene ensembl,h."Gene name" gene_name,
 TRY_CAST(h.nTPM AS DOUBLE) hpa,TRY_CAST(g.nTPM AS DOUBLE) gtex,
 TRY_CAST(c.nTPM AS DOUBLE) consensus,p."RNA tissue specificity" specificity
 FROM rna_tissue_hpa h JOIN rna_tissue_gtex g ON h.Gene=g.Gene AND h.Tissue=g.Tissue
 JOIN proteinatlas p ON h.Gene=p.Ensembl
 LEFT JOIN rna_tissue_consensus c ON h.Gene=c.Gene AND h.Tissue=c.Tissue
 WHERE lower(h.Tissue) IN ('colon','ovary','testis')
 AND lower(p."Protein class") LIKE '%transcription factors%'
), elig AS (SELECT *, log2((hpa+1)/(gtex+1)) ld FROM base WHERE isfinite(hpa) AND isfinite(gtex) AND hpa>=0 AND gtex>=0),
r AS (SELECT *, rank() OVER(PARTITION BY tissue ORDER BY hpa DESC,ensembl) rh,rank() OVER(PARTITION BY tissue ORDER BY gtex DESC,ensembl) rg,
 (rank() OVER(PARTITION BY tissue ORDER BY hpa)+(count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY tissue,hpa)-1)/2.0) ar_h,
 (rank() OVER(PARTITION BY tissue ORDER BY gtex)+(count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY tissue,gtex)-1)/2.0) ar_g
 FROM elig), a AS (SELECT tissue,count(*) eligible, corr(ar_h,ar_g) spearman,median(abs(ld)) median_abs_log2diff FROM r GROUP BY tissue),
topunion AS (SELECT * FROM r WHERE rh<=20 OR rg<=20), ov AS (SELECT tissue,count(*) FILTER(WHERE rh<=20) hpa_top_n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE rg<=20) gtex_top_n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE rh<=20 AND rg<=20) overlap FROM r GROUP BY tissue),
disc AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY tissue ORDER BY abs(ld) DESC,ensembl) dn FROM r)
SELECT 'AGGREGATE' section,tissue,CAST(eligible AS VARCHAR) v1,CAST(spearman AS VARCHAR) v2,CAST(median_abs_log2diff AS VARCHAR) v3,'' v4,'' v5,'' v6,'' v7,'' v8 FROM a
UNION ALL SELECT 'OVERLAP',tissue,CAST(hpa_top_n AS VARCHAR),CAST(gtex_top_n AS VARCHAR),CAST(overlap AS VARCHAR),CAST(overlap*1.0/(hpa_top_n+gtex_top_n-overlap) AS VARCHAR),'','','','','' FROM ov
UNION ALL SELECT 'TOP_UNION',tissue,ensembl,gene_name,CAST(hpa AS VARCHAR),CAST(gtex AS VARCHAR),CAST(rh AS VARCHAR),CAST(rg AS VARCHAR),CAST(consensus AS VARCHAR),specificity,CAST(ld AS VARCHAR) FROM topunion
UNION ALL SELECT 'DISCREPANCY',tissue,ensembl,gene_name,CAST(hpa AS VARCHAR),CAST(gtex AS VARCHAR),CAST(ld AS VARCHAR),CAST(abs(ld) AS VARCHAR),CAST(consensus AS VARCHAR),specificity,CAST(dn AS VARCHAR) FROM disc WHERE dn<=10
ORDER BY section,tissue,TRY_CAST(v8 AS INTEGER),v1"}

turns.text:
## Design and eligibility

I used the separate `rna_tissue_hpa` and `rna_tissue_gtex` nTPM tables—not the consensus table—for HPA–GTEx comparisons. The universe was restricted to Ensembl genes present in the HPA master (`proteinatlas`) table whose `Protein class` contains **“Transcription factors”**. For each tissue, eligible genes had finite, non-negative nTPM in both sources.

All three tissues had **1,483 eligible transcription-factor genes**. Rankings use descending nTPM and break ties by Ensembl ID. Spearman ranks use average ranks for tied expression values.

## Agreement summary

| Tissue | Eligible TF genes | Spearman ρ | Median \|log2((HPA+1)/(GTEx+1))\| | HPA top-20 | GTEx top-20 | Overlap | Jaccard |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Colon | 1,483 | 0.9116508243 | 0.3719687774 | 20 | 20 | 11 | 0.3793103448 |
| Ovary | 1,483 | 0.9479850725 | 0.2756344426 | 20 | 20 | 14 | 0.5384615385 |
| Testis | 1,483 | 0.9150135937 | 0.3219280949 | 20 | 20 | 12 | 0.4285714286 |

### Overlap bars

```text
Colon   HPA [====================] 20
        GTEx[====================] 20     shared [###########---------] 11; J=0.3793

Ovary   HPA [====================] 20
        GTEx[====================] 20     shared [##############------] 14; J=0.5385

Testis  HPA [====================] 20
        GTEx[====================] 20     shared [############--------] 12; J=0.4286
```
